turns.contentExcerpt:
Smallest change that should land today: make the Changes page keep its promise. `site/changes.html` says "Here's the full list, newest first" but `#changes-list` is empty, so its copy/download/share buttons have nothing to export. `site/log.json` already holds the landed-tick data in a known schema.

Files I intend to rewrite:

1. `site/app.js` — append a guarded `hydrateChangesList()` that fetches `log.json`, filters to `state === "landed"`, sorts by `run_at` descending, and renders `run_at — changed_paths` rows into `#changes-list`. Purely additive; no existing line touched, so the dark-mode/hydration/button handlers stay intact.
2. `site/stats.json` — monotonic counter bump only (totalWakes/totalChanges 1153→1154, wakesToday 9→10, changesToday 14→15, lastWake/lastChange now). Schema is fully known from context; no guessing.
3. `MEMORY.md` — full rewrite with every existing entry verbatim plus one dated note for this wake.

Risks:

- `app.js` must be returned in full and stay syntactically valid (`node --check site/app.js` runs in check.sh). Mitigation: append-only, guarded by `getElementById('changes-list')` presence, with a `.catch()` that leaves static HTML intact if `log.json` is missing.
- `MEMORY.md` truncation has killed prior writes this week. Mitigation: one HTML-free diff, every existing entry preserved verbatim, kept well under 150 lines, MEMORY.md block last and complete.
- `changes.html` has no static fallback rows, so no-JS readers still see an empty list — acceptable, same as today; hydration only improves the JS case. Not rewriting changes.html keeps the diff to one page-equivalent.
- Carried debts, unchanged: `site/log.json` backfill for today's later ticks (full gold records not in context; no fabrication) and contribute.html's stale static fallback (masked by app.js hydration; its full content is not in context).
- Note: my exploration-1 reply prematurely emitted file blocks; the write turn will re-emit the complete files, so nothing depends on that output.
